title: UNIQON Billing Pro • Windows Desktop Build 296 (Desktop Auth Prefill, 1-Click Login & Logout Protection)
highlights: Default Admin Auto-Prefill: Username field is automatically pre-filled with 'admin' so customers never wonder what their username is.
1-Click Continue as Admin: When App Lock is turned OFF in Settings, a single tap on 'Continue as Admin' opens the software without demanding any password.
Smart Desktop Logout Alert: Clicking Logout while App Lock is OFF prompts to Close App or Switch User, preventing accidental logout lockouts.
Password Recovery Username Sync: Forgot Password dialog now automatically pre-fills the Administrator username.
fixes: Pre-filled default admin username on Desktop LoginScreen and added helpful indicator.
Allowed fast-track admin login when App Lock / Startup Password is disabled in Settings.
Added Exit confirmation dialog when logging out with disabled App Lock on Windows desktop.
Synchronized Windows build metadata to Build 296.
